title: Supercritical Schrödinger equations involving integro-differential operators and vanishing potentials
summary: This paper is devoted to the study of the existence of positive and bounded solutions for a Schrödinger type equation defined on the entire Euclidean space, involving a general integro-differential operator. We consider the case where the potential is nonnegative and vanishes at infinity with a nonlinearity exhibiting critical or supercritical growth in the Sobolev sense. To overcome the lack of compactness and the difficulties imposed by the general structure of the nonlinearity, we employ variational methods combined with a penalization technique.
